current_mpp_policy.decision: Phase 2选定软对比联合学习作为当前研究主线，优先针对本数据调优，使其相对冻结UNI2-h加两层MLP的对照获得更清楚的指标改善；具体模型改动后续讨论。全部已列指标暂时待定，后续实验保留计算和记录，逐通路平均PCC与展平/整体PCC均保留，论文采用及主副线后续再定。指标主要用于本项目内部前后与实验对照，暂不开展跨论文实验数值优劣比较。六折留一患者继续暂缓；基因重建、稠密/稀疏验证、多基础模型和Phase 2/3衔接补充实验后置，在软对比指标改善后再推进。本次只登记决策，不启动训练或改变既有结果确认状态。
current_mpp_policy.rationale: 用户本轮会议选择软对比学习继续作为主线；已有成绩尚未证实相对简单回归有稳定优势，提升是后续目标。
current_mpp_policy.next_recommended_experiment: 优先讨论针对本数据的软对比改进方案；六折暂缓，其余补充实验后置；本轮不执行实验。

experiments.decision_gate: A0b serves as the clean-token (cls_patch64) baseline for A1 comparison.
experiments.notes: GFNet cls_patch64 (CLS + 64 patch tokens, no register). Excludes register tokens from FFT sequence. Train-Val Gap narrows slightly vs legacy (0.160 vs 0.168).

experiments.decision_gate: A1 vs A0b: modReLU degraded val_loss (-2.2%), val_pcc (-6.1%), Train-Val Gap widened (+50%). Gate: FAIL → frequency sparsification hypothesis disproven. A2 (frequency augmentation) and A3 (AFNO) cancelled.
experiments.notes: modReLU magnitude threshold truncates weak frequency components, discarding subtle tissue texture info. Some pathways improved (MYC, Wound Healing) but more degraded (Coagulation, Inflammatory Response, E2F, OxPhos). Epoch window delayed (E4 vs E2) but overall worse.

experiments.decision_gate: B1a vs B1b: peak PCC 0.3956 vs 0.3955 — nearly identical. Frequency branch adds no incremental value over mean pooling. Both below CLS Frozen baseline (0.4113). Gate: FAIL → frequency side-branch disproven for CLS mode.
experiments.notes: CLS + GFNet frequency branch on patch tokens. Confounding variable: token_select_mode changed from legacy_firstN to cls_patch64 simultaneously with freq_branch addition. CLS cls_patch64 alone may already degrade vs legacy. Without freq=none + cls_patch64 control, cannot fully isolate freq_branch effect.

experiments.decision_gate: B1b (mean pool) same as B1a (gfnet) → frequency branch has no mechanism advantage. Both < CLS Frozen 0.4113. The CLS+patching side-branch architecture itself may not help.
experiments.notes: Non-frequency control for B1a. Mean pooling on patch tokens as side branch. Result confirms frequency processing is NOT the differentiator — both branches perform similarly below baseline.

V3bis: fix V3 overfitting by introducing internal val patient ZHZ. 5 train patients (HYZ,JFX,LMZ,TGC,XSL) -> 1 internal val (ZHZ, val_loss early stopping) -> 1 external test (XZY, single eval after checkpoint selection). Three-layer signal separation. z-score fit on 5 train patients only. val_loss_min selects best checkpoint and triggers early stopping. Min_stop_epoch=max(patience,3).

MPP1 partner training using ljk's pre-extracted features (MPP1_UNI/). 5 train patients (JFX,LMZ12939,TGC,XSL,ZHZ) -> 1 internal val (HYZ15040, val_loss early stopping) -> 1 external test (XZY). XZY cache loaded from MPP1_UNI (only complete copy). ljk's .pt cache stores 265 tokens [265,1536] — auto-detected and CLS extracted. use_partner_paths=True, auto_split=True.

MPP4 partner training using ljk's pre-extracted features (MPP4_UNI/). 5 train patients (JFX,LMZ12939,TGC,XSL,ZHZ) -> 1 internal val (HYZ15040, val_loss early stopping) -> 1 external test (XZY). XZY cache loaded from MPP1_UNI (only complete copy). Fast training (~4s/ep) suggests smaller training set.

MPP2 partner training by wzk. Uses same protocol (5 train + HYZ15040 val + XZY external). Training stopped at ep33 (lr=1.25e-05). Best by val_loss: ep13 (val_loss=0.2360, val_PCC=0.6625). External XZY PCC=0.4555 — significantly below MPP1 (0.71)/MPP3 (0.67). Possible z-score mismatch or cache quality issue.

MPP5 partner training by wzk. 132 epochs with lr decay (1e-4→7.8e-07). Best by val_loss: ep112 (val_loss=0.1300, val_PCC=0.8459, train_PCC=0.98). Despite best val metrics of all 5 MPPs, external XZY PCC only 0.4472 — extreme val↔ext disconnect. Strongly suggests z-score or cache incompatibility with the common XZY test set.

MPP1-5 unified-standard rerun (2026-07-06 plan). Per-patient 10% internal val via spatial block split; train-only z-score rebuilt from raw ssGSEA; MPP-2/XZY fixed external test. Reuses MPP1_UNI partner cache (cross train/val subdir merge by stem). 100% stride MPP, no embargo. Raw-scale MAE/R2 mandatory. 2026-07-09: temporarily abandoned for follow-up despite highest PCC; retain only as PCC-upper-bound background.

metric_definitions.pcc: 逐通路平均 PCC（即患者—通路等权平均 PCC）：每患者每通路PCC，再患者等权、通路等权算术平均；本轮选择及主报告口径。
metric_definitions.ccc: 每患者每通路标准化CCC，患者/通路等权；同通路线性反标准化不改变CCC。
metric_definitions.spearman: 每患者每通路Spearman（并列秩取平均），患者/通路等权。
metric_definitions.z_rmse: 先每患者每通路开方均方误差，再患者/通路等权；不是pooled_z_rmse。
metric_definitions.z_mae: 每患者每通路标准化绝对误差，患者/通路等权。
metric_definitions.raw_mae: 每患者每通路原始单位MAE，患者/通路等权；仅使用训练集均值/SD反标准化。
metric_definitions.raw_r2: 每患者每通路R²，患者/通路等权；与该通路z域R²相同，低方差可造成大负值。
metric_definitions.residual_moran: 每患者每通路z残差Moran I，再患者/通路等权；回传固定有向图去自环权重，行权重不重归一，N/S0校正；XZY无回传边表为null。
metric_definitions.bias_z: 每患者每通路预测减真值均值，再患者/通路等权。
metric_definitions.pred_truth_sd_ratio: 每患者每通路预测SD/真值SD（ddof=0），再患者/通路等权。
metric_definitions.pooled_pathway_pcc: 各患者点位合并后逐通路PCC，再通路均值，含患者间差异。
metric_definitions.pooled_z_rmse: 全部点位×通路z域均方误差开方。
metric_definitions.flattened_pcc: 平均池化 pooled PCC（整体展平 PCC）：全部点位×通路z域展平PCC；历史合同pooled_pcc别名仅指此值。
metric_definitions.pooled_z_mse: 全部点位×通路z域均方误差。
metric_definitions.patient_macro_z_mse_selection: 每患者全点位×通路z域均方误差，再患者等权；内部best与回传tie_metric逐项核对。
metric_definitions.train_sd_normalized_nrmse: 先合并全部患者点位，再每通路RMSE_raw/SD_train，最后通路均值；等于pooled逐通路zRMSE，原local analyzer口径。
metric_definitions.patient_macro_train_sd_nrmse: 每患者每通路RMSE_raw/SD_train，患者/通路等权；与z_rmse相同，单独说明聚合差异。
metric_definitions.flattened_z_ccc: 原local analyzer口径：全部点位×通路z域展平CCC，不是宏平均CCC。
metric_definitions.flattened_z_spearman: 原local analyzer口径：全部点位×通路z域展平Spearman，不是宏平均Spearman。
metric_definitions.flattened_raw_r2: 原local analyzer口径：原始单位矩阵整体展平R²，共用整体真值均值；不是逐通路R²。
metric_definitions.pooled_z_mae: 原local analyzer口径：全部点位×通路标准化MAE。
metric_definitions.pooled_raw_mae: 原local analyzer口径：全部点位×通路原始单位MAE，患者按点位数加权。
metric_definitions.fisher_patient_pathway_pcc: 兼容20260905合同：每通路各患者PCC先clip±0.999999、atanh求均值后tanh，再通路算术平均；历史基线也同口径重算。

aggregation_notes.seed_std: 样本标准差ddof=1，三随机种子仅反映训练随机性，不是患者泛化CI。
aggregation_notes.distributions: 先跨种子取均值；逐通路分布先患者等权（PCC另给Fisher）；同时保留患者分布、患者×通路分布。分位数linear。
aggregation_notes.historical_reference: historical_FBR仅1个种子；同源真值下算术/Fisher口径均重算；不是本轮新训练，也不可与旧pooled PCC混用。

mean_per_pathway_masked_ssim.reason: 有效空间栅格、占用mask和窗口未预定义，不事后任意选择

confidence_interval.reason: 未开展bootstrap；外部仅1患者，患者级泛化CI不可估计，种子std不替代CI

normalization.clip_note: pred_raw = pred_z * train_sd + train_mean，只逆变换一次，不对预测再裁剪。

display_names.flattened_pcc: 平均池化 pooled PCC（整体展平 PCC）

definitions.pcc: Within each patient and pathway, Pearson across spots, then equal arithmetic mean over patients/pathways.
definitions.flattened_pcc: Pearson across flattened all-spots x all-pathways z-score matrices; legacy pooled_pcc alias.
definitions.pooled_pathway_pcc: Separate third metric: pool patients spots within each pathway, Pearson, then equal mean across pathways.

policy.note_zh: 两个主PCC必须并列；合并点位逐通路PCC另列。整体值包含跨患者/通路差异，不能按绝对数值高低互证优越。平均池化不是新增网络层。

experiments.display_name: Phase 2 软连接对比学习改进实验 v3（设计 v4）
experiments.objective: 在原六患者空间块划分、种子42下比较冻结回归、软对比LoRA和阶段二点位/空间头，并在训练与模型选择结束后对XZY作只读参考评估。
experiments.registration_scope: 用户授权登记完整训练与XZY外部推理事实；登记不等同结果accepted或机制因果结论确认。

completion_evidence.immutable_snapshot_note: 初始run.json保留首次失败快照；最终完成状态以raw/engine_state.json和logs/resume_history.jsonl末条成功记录共同判定。

data_contract.normalization: 仅使用训练块拟合的30通路均值与标准差；内部验证及XZY不拟合参数。
data_contract.internal_evidence_scope: 同患者空间块内部验证，不是患者独立验证。
data_contract.external_evidence_scope: XZY历史已见，只作外部参考评估，不是全新盲测队列。

selection_contract.learning_rate_selection: 种子42的r8_regression固定第5轮内部验证patient_macro_pathway_pcc，继以zMSE及较小学习率打平。

metric_definitions.patient_macro_pathway_pcc: 逐患者逐通路PCC后患者与通路等权平均；XZY单患者时为30通路PCC算术平均。
metric_definitions.pooled_pcc: 全部点位乘通路的z分数整体展平后计算一次PCC。
metric_definitions.aggregation_note: 两种PCC聚合和标度不同，必须并列报告，不能以数值高低互证优越。

experiments.result_interpretation_boundary: 当前为已登记待审结果；未标记accepted，不形成机制因果结论，原因分析与报告撰写另行进行。

experiments.display_name: Phase 2 完整继承单点模型与空间修正 v1
experiments.objective: 从阶段一冻结纯回归第5轮完整继承H/C，比较仅训练空间残差B、继续训练H/C及联合训练H/C/B，并在内部验证选模冻结后对XZY作外部评估。
experiments.registration_scope: 用户在完整结果审核后明确授权登记并接纳；接纳限于该单种子、单外部患者运行事实，不构成广泛泛化或机制因果结论。

data_contract.normalization: 仅使用来源训练集z-score；内部验证及XZY不拟合参数。
data_contract.internal_evidence_scope: 同患者空间块内部验证，不是患者独立验证。
data_contract.external_evidence_scope: XZY为单患者且历史已见，只作外部参考评估，不是全新盲测队列。

metric_definitions.patient_macro_pathway_pcc: 逐患者逐通路PCC后等权平均；XZY单患者时等于30通路PCC算术平均。
metric_definitions.flattened_pooled_pcc: 全部点位乘通路的训练z-score矩阵整体展平后计算一次PCC；pooled_pcc为同义别名。
metric_definitions.zMSE: 全部点位乘通路的训练z-score尺度均方误差。
metric_definitions.aggregation_note: 两种PCC聚合不同，必须并列报告，不能以绝对数值高低互证优越。

raw_scale_metrics.reason: 当前warm-start bundle未嵌入来源训练集mean/std，不能审计原始尺度反变换。

experiments.accepted_conclusion: 在预定内部验证规则下spatial_joint被选中；其XZY双PCC和zMSE均优于来源step0。固定beta=1诊断的双PCC更高但zMSE略差，且未参与选择。结果仅支持该单种子、单外部患者范围，不证明全面优于固定平滑或广泛跨患者泛化。
